main_text.p: τῷ Συνόδῳ [?]οἰκουμενικῷ, εἰς πᾶσαν [illegible, ~12 letters] Deinde omnem operam dedit, vt ex alijs Patriarchijs legatos euocaret, Concilium-que generale cogeret, eamque rem perfecit. Primum itaque decretum Nicolai sequens Imperator Photium expulit, Ignatium restituit. Deinde aduentum Legatorum ex alijs Patriarchijs procurauit, & Synodum cogit. Statim itaque atque confalutatus est Basilius Imperator deiectionem Photij, & restitutionem Ignatij meditatus, tribus diebus, vt videre est, absoluit. Non potuit ergo Photius Basilium, quem eo tempore nec viderat plane, vti homicidam a communione repellere: nec potuit Basilius, cum in occupando, atq; stabiliendo Imperio totus inuigilaret, sacris mysterijs adesse; nec potuit illo trium dierum spatio a tribunali Pontificio in fauorem Ignatij placitum obtinere, quo innixus depositionem Photij, & restitutionem Ignatij obfirmaret: nisi missi Basilij ad Romanum, rursusque Legati Pontificij ad Basilium ad abrogandum Photio magistratum sphærulæ fuere plumbeæ pyrio puluere ex tormento æneo violenter ex-pulsæ, vel vortex igneus ab Oriente in Occidentem recurrens, retortusque per partes omnes perleui momento, qui perexiguo trium dierum tempore, certe cursu præuer-

page.notes: The first Greek line is partly uncertain: the first word and the words after "οἰκουμενικῷ" are doubtful. The second Greek line that runs into the text is illegible. Left to right, the Greek opens the page as a continuation of the previous paragraph. The word "tere" at the bottom right is the catchword for the next page.
